text:
maria: quick check — thinking about how the console should surface *why* an automatic fallback fired during a rollout. we currently show a tiny 'fallback' badge and a raw blob if you click through. UX is confusing. Should we surface human-readable decision flags + a compact timeline? :thinking:

ajay: +1. backend currently returns a bitmask and a raw reason_codes array. we can map to stable labels and present a primary + secondary reasons. prototype payload idea:
```
{
  "decision_id": "dec-1234",
  "triggers": ["latency_p90", "5xx_rate"],
  "primary": "latency_p90",
  "raw": { /* full runtime payload, scrubbed */ }
}
```

sam: perf note — avoid fetching full raw for every fallback in the UI. we should sample raw payloads and show aggregated counts + a link to fetch a sampled example. otherwise huge pages and slow lists.

cleo: auditability: persist (decision_id, trace_id, operator_override) in the audit log. also need a retention and PII-scrubbing policy for any raw payload. cc @maria

maria: agree on scrub + sample. UI idea: show primary trigger (big), short summary (counts, last seen), and an expand to view 'raw' only for operators with permission. also allow filtering rollouts by trigger tag (e.g., show all rollouts that had latency_p95 fallbacks last 24h).

ajay: backend API suggestion: add an endpoint `/api/v1/rollouts/{rid}/decisions` which returns lightweight records and supports `?sample_rate=0.01&since=...`. include `decision_flags` list and an optional `sampled_raw_url`. include a `confidence` score for noisy signals.

sam: also include total counts and sampling metadata so frontend can scale numbers: e.g., total_fallbacks: 120, sampled: 3, sample_rate: 0.02. that avoids user confusion when counts don't match examples.

cleo: operator override UX — show sticky override with TTL and who toggled it. e.g., "Operator override (cleo) — expires in 2h" and include link to audit entry. we should also surface when an override caused subsequent fallbacks to be suppressed.

maria: example lightweight JSON to prototype UI with:
```
{
  "decision_id": "dec-20260321-01",
  "triggers": ["latency_p95"],
  "primary": "latency_p95",
  "counts": {"since": "2026-03-21T09:00Z", "total": 47},
  "sampled_raw_url": "/internal/rollouts/dec-2026/raw/1",
  "operator_override": null
}
```

deploy-bot: Rollout service v2.14 deployed to staging :rocket:

ajay: i'll mock the API + add a compact frontend card: big primary trigger chip + secondary tags + expand for sampled raw. aim to demo Wed.

maria: action items: ajay — prototype API & frontend card; cleo — define audit fields and retention/scrubbing policy (decision_id, trace_id, operator, scrubbed_raw); sam — add sampling knobs and quota guardrails for raw fetches. i'll collect UX feedback in the rollout playbook doc.

sam: sounds good. :thumbsup:

cleo: will draft the PII scrub rules and retention TTL (30 days for sampled raw, indexed decision metadata for 1 year).

maria: thanks team! i'll follow up with a small mock and some screenshots.
